## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that adjusting the shotgun_scalper's exit and trigger parameters (take-profit, stop-loss, time stop, chandelier arm, strike offset, volume ratio threshold) can improve alignment with J's anchor days by capturing more of the winner-day potential while reducing losses on loser days. The edge exists because the default parameters may not be optimal for the specific volatility and volume conditions present on J's selected trade days.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Trigger when volume ratio exceeds 1.2 (`vol_ratio_threshold`) and strike is set to 2 strikes OTM (`strike_offset=2`).  
**Exit:**  
- Take profit at 75% premium gain (`tp_premium_pct=0.75`)  
- Stop loss at 35% premium loss (`stop_premium_pct=-0.35`)  
- Time stop at 12 minutes (`time_stop_min=12`)  
- Chandelier profit-lock arms at 60% gain (`chandelier_arm_pct=0.6`) and trails 15% off the high-water mark
